inputs.checklistItemText: Driveways do not maintain minimum 16-foot vertical clearance (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot vertical clearance (areas with truck traffic) from lowest point of overhead electric facilities including telecommunications attachments
inputs.question: Are there any sections or profiles showing driveway elevations relative to overhead electric lines? Are vertical clearance dimensions (16 feet or 18 feet) shown for any driveways?
inputs.regionHint: Look at any cross-sections showing driveways and check for overhead line references

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether specific drawing elements (sections, profiles, vertical clearance dimensions) are present and shown on the plans—a drawing-inspection task—rather than asking the agent to measure clearance directly. This is a progressive verification step to identify whether the necessary drawing components exist before attempting clearance measurement.
